prompt_policy: Card names and the unseen archetype name are external metadata only and never enter model prompts. Prompts match the project's Yu-Gi-Oh art-sample schema and canonical metadata openings. hclar52 occurs exactly once in each art_style. Bounding boxes use stored [y_min,x_min,y_max,x_max] order.
negative_prompt: card frame, card border, title, lettering, readable text, logo, watermark, signature, interface, cropped anatomy, duplicate limbs, extra fingers, photorealism

prompt.high_level_description: A Spellcaster-type MONSTER card artwork showing the following scene: a masked spectral archivist writes a luminous sentence into the air while the surrounding manuscript pages erase themselves.

style_description.lighting: cold blue-white ink light cutting through deep indigo library shadows
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, polished digital dark-fantasy rendering with crisp silhouettes, ornate fabric and controlled magical particles

compositional_deconstruction.background: An immense archive aisle converges into blue-black darkness behind the figure. Tall lacquered shelves lean subtly inward, while a single spiral of blank vellum sheets leads from the lower foreground toward the raised quill. The pages break into small luminous square fragments near the upper edge.

elements.desc: A slender young spectral archivist dominates the square in a low-angle three-quarter pose. Layered black academic robes with restrained silver embroidery flare into a strong triangular silhouette. A smooth ivory porcelain mask with one hairline crack hides the face. The forward hand aims an oversized silver-nib quill toward the viewer, and a ribbon of blue-white liquid light curves from its tip across the torso.

prompt.high_level_description: A Field SPELL card artwork showing the following scene: an impossible black library suspended outside reality erases its own shelves and manuscripts in a vast spiral of luminous ink.

style_description.lighting: radiant cyan-white manuscript light surrounded by near-black architectural shadows
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, highly detailed digital fantasy environment rendering with clear one-point perspective and sublime scale

compositional_deconstruction.background: A cathedral-sized archive uses strict one-point perspective down a long central aisle toward a distant ivory reading dais. Colossal black shelves curve inward like the ribs of a vault. Beyond the upper shelves is a starless void, and several architectural sections end in unnaturally clean empty gaps as though cut from existence.

elements.desc: A broad helix of thousands of blank ivory manuscript leaves rises from the central aisle and coils around the distant reading dais. The lower pages remain tactile and sharply folded, while the upper pages dissolve into geometric blue-white ink fragments that form a radiant circular aperture above the vanishing point. Tiny empty reading desks establish the impossible scale without introducing characters.

prompt.high_level_description: A Spellcaster-type XYZ MONSTER card artwork showing the following scene: a colossal masked grand librarian rewrites a broken magical attack into a procession of vanishing manuscript pages.

style_description.lighting: brilliant white-violet halo light opposed by fractured crimson magic
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, premium digital dark-fantasy rendering with monumental anatomy, ornate regalia and sharply controlled energy effects

compositional_deconstruction.background: A ruined circular archive chamber recedes through violet haze. Broken black shelves and suspended staircases form a restrained radial frame. Eight small dark orbs ring the upper halo like pieces of erased punctuation, while distant parchment fragments establish depth.

elements.desc: A towering spectral grand librarian fills the square in a frontal low-angle composition. Layered black ceremonial robes spread like vast wings and carry thin silver lines resembling abstract illuminated margins. A severe ivory mask has no mouth and bears a vertical violet fracture. Four long articulated arms form a circular gesture around an open blank codex, creating an unmistakable symmetrical silhouette beneath a radiant manuscript halo.

A jagged crimson magical blast enters from the lower left and crosses toward the codex. At the central overlap it changes abruptly into a disciplined stream of blank ivory pages, then disintegrates into blue-white square fragments flowing toward the upper right. The transformation reads clearly as one hostile effect being rewritten rather than merely blocked.
